text: Customers may return unused products within 30 days of purchase. Refunds are processed within five business days after approval.
Standard shipping takes three to five business days. Express shipping takes one to two business days.
The company encrypts customer data in transit using TLS and at rest using AES-256.
Customer support is available Monday through Friday from 9 AM to 6 PM Eastern time.
New customers receive a 14-day free trial. A payment method is required to start a paid plan after the trial.
Subscriptions renew monthly. Customers can cancel before the next billing date to prevent a new charge.
Account owners can request deletion of personal information through the privacy portal.
Encrypted daily backups are retained for 30 days. Disaster recovery tests run each quarter.
